name: es20-indexed-drawing
title: Indexed drawing
summary: glDrawElements with UNSIGNED_BYTE/SHORT/INT indices and byte offsets into the index buffer, vertex reuse, glBufferSubData and glBufferData re-specification (size/usage queries, orphaning), glIsBuffer, and the VAO-owned ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER binding, validated against a CPU barycentric reference.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.10.1 Creating and Binding Buffer Objects, §2.10.2 Creating Buffer Object Data Stores
ES 3.0 §2.10.4 Effects of Accessing Outside Buffer Bounds, §2.10.6 Vertex Arrays in Buffer Objects
ES 3.0 §2.10.7 Array Indices in Buffer Objects, §2.10.8 Buffer Object State
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.4 Input Variables, §4.3.8.1 Input Layout Qualifiers

api.glGenBuffers: vertex and index buffers feeding the validated draws
api.glBindBuffer: ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER binding recorded per VAO (queried); unbinding with a VAO bound detaches only that VAO's index buffer; deleting a bound buffer resets the binding
api.glBufferData: index/vertex data observed through pixels; BUFFER_SIZE and BUFFER_USAGE read back after every specification, all nine usage values round-trip; negative size -> INVALID_VALUE; NULL data = orphaning
api.glBufferSubData: index range and one vertex rewritten between draws, observed through pixels; size/usage unchanged; offset+size past the end and negative offset -> INVALID_VALUE; no buffer bound -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glDeleteBuffers: glIsBuffer FALSE afterwards, ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING reset to 0; cleanup with final glGetError == NO_ERROR
api.glIsBuffer: FALSE for a generated unbound name, TRUE after bind, FALSE after delete
api.glGetBufferParameteriv: BUFFER_SIZE and BUFFER_USAGE of 7 static buffers and after each step of the mutation sequence; INVALID_OPERATION with no buffer bound
api.glGenVertexArrays: six VAOs with different index buffers
api.glBindVertexArray: selects the index buffer: two VAOs draw different triangle sets without glBindBuffer
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: position and color arrays sourced from the vertex buffers (VAOs and VAO 0)
api.glDisableVertexAttribArray: VAO 0 arrays reset after the client-index draw
api.glVertexAttribPointer: interleaved stride/offset recorded per VAO; observed through pixels
api.glGetVertexAttribiv: VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING still the same buffer after re-specification
api.glDrawElements: UNSIGNED_BYTE / UNSIGNED_SHORT / UNSIGNED_INT (indices > 65535) indices, byte offset into the buffer, partial counts, client-memory indices on VAO 0; count = -1 -> INVALID_VALUE and nothing drawn
api.glDrawArrays: 54 expanded vertices produce the same picture as the indexed draw
api.glGetIntegerv: ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING per VAO, ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING across VAO switches
api.glGetError: negative-case errors read right after the offending call, drained and compared in expect_gl_error
api.glUseProgram: mesh program used for all draws
api.glViewport: one viewport per tile; centroid pixels probed
api.glClearColor: absent triangles and tile corners show the clear color
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of every probed pixel

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture: 4x4 tiles of the same colorful 3x3-cell mesh on a dark-blue background. Row 0: three identical full meshes (UBYTE, USHORT, UINT) and a fourth missing its bottom row of cells. Row 1: full mesh; mesh with a dark hole in the center; mesh with a bright white displaced vertex in the center; mesh with inverted colors. Row 2: mesh with rotated colors; a checkerboard of cell pairs; full mesh; full mesh (client indices). Row 3: full mesh (non-indexed); an empty tile (failed draw); full mesh (failed glBufferSubData left it intact); only the bottom row of cells. Smooth gradients, no stray triangles and no magenta decoy anywhere.
